headline: Bottom two at Marassi: the market still leans to the home side
summary: Genoa host Venezia at Marassi on Sunday with the bottom two in Serie A meeting: 17th with 4 points against 20th with 3. Venezia arrive in better mood — Davide Nicola won his first game 1-0 against Napoli — but the market makes Genoa 45% favourites, with Venezia at 24.9% and the draw at 30.1%. Genoa create little: 1.13 expected goals a game after a 0-2 defeat at Roma. Their advantage is small, about a quarter of a goal on the handicap. Venezia concede 2.27 expected goals against, yet Over 2.5 goals has slipped from 50.4% to 48.1%. Home ground, not form, explains the price.

facts.fact: Genoa and Venezia are the bottom two in Serie A — 17th hosting 20th.
facts.meaning: A direct relegation six-pointer in late October, with both clubs already in the drop zone.

facts.fact: Venezia beat Napoli 1-0 on 17 October for their first Serie A points of the season, in Davide Nicola's first match in charge.
facts.meaning: They travel to Genoa with the mood around the club transformed after a winless start.

facts.fact: Genoa lost 0-2 at Roma on 17 October.
facts.meaning: A second heavy away defeat leaves the home side short of confidence going into a game they are expected to win.

facts.fact: The market makes Genoa 45.0% favourites to win on home soil.
facts.meaning: Favourites, but nowhere near a safe price — this is a bottom-two game and the draw takes a big share.

facts.fact: Genoa coach Daniele De Rossi called Sunday's game a relegation battle but 'not a last chance', with his side on 4 points from seven matches.
facts.meaning: The home coach accepts the pressure around the fixture without treating it as decisive.

facts.fact: Venezia's last five matches have averaged 2.27 xG against per game.
facts.meaning: Their games are open and chances flow at both ends — they have to outscore opponents to get anything.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is -0.35 goals, rating Genoa about a third of a goal the better side.
facts.meaning: Genoa are only marginal favourites on the handicap — a draw would leave the quarter-ball backers half-beaten.

facts.fact: Genoa's treatment room is clearing: Hamed Traorè will be available despite a minor muscle issue and Baldanzi is back in the group, leaving L. Venturino (knee) as their one listed absentee.
facts.meaning: De Rossi has attacking options he could not be sure of earlier in the week.

sources.fact: Genoa coach Daniele De Rossi said the match against Venezia will be a relegation battle but not a last chance.
Italian media describe Sunday's Genoa-Venezia match as a relegation fight (match salvezza).
Hamed Traorè had a minor muscle issue but will be available against Venezia, and Baldanzi has also returned to the group.
Genoa hope to recover several players, with Ehizibue fit and Meichtry and Colombo in a race against time.
Italian media report Genoa are managing a crowded treatment room before the Venezia match.
Genoa are set to return to a back four against Venezia, with De Rossi hoping to repeat the first half they played against Fiorentina.
Davide Nicola was appointed Venezia head coach and won his debut match 1-0 against Napoli.
Venezia beat Napoli 1-0 for their first Serie A points of the season, with Akor Adams scoring.
